name: Goiânia

queries.query: Goiânia mapa cadastral lote parcelário prefeitura mapa digital oficial MUBDG
queries.scope: Find the official Goiânia lot/parcel map and public vector query.
queries.result: The City of Goiânia geoprocessing service page, managed by SEPLAN, links the Geo 360° map viewer. The older MUBDG page describes version 9 with 391 bairros, 17,505 blocks, 310,134 lots and 9,171 streets. The current linked viewer page opened without readable feature content; a WUP-centered map URL could not be fetched.
queries.executionMethod: Web search plus read-only inspection of the city service page and linked map.

queries.query: site:goiania.go.gov.br MUBDG SIGGO lote quadra geoprocessamento parcel map
queries.scope: Check parcel counts, the source custodian, and access/usage conditions.
queries.result: Official MUBDG page reports lots and blocks in the city map. The municipal geoprocessing page documents a map-cutout request workflow. A published SIGGO use term says the spatial database is for municipal departments and third-party use requires permission; redistribution is restricted. No current public full-polygon endpoint or open-data license was verified.

queries.query: Goiânia city cadastral lots official parcel map Geo 360 MUBDG
queries.scope: Cross-check English references and official city viewer routes.
queries.result: The official municipal service page confirms the Geo 360° viewer; no English-language separate parcel API or public data download was found.

portals.name: Mapa Geo 360° Goiânia
portals.operator: Prefeitura de Goiânia, Secretaria Municipal de Planejamento e Urbanismo Estratégico (SEPLAN)
portals.observation: HTTP 200 viewer shell is linked by the official city service page. Bundle/API discovery confirms the public ICAD Lote polygon layer and full-geometry retrieval; WUP locator queries were empty.

portals.name: Mapa Urbano Básico Digital de Goiânia (MUBDG)
portals.operator: Prefeitura de Goiânia, city geoprocessing department / SEPLAN
portals.observation: Official page reports MUBDG v9 totals of 310,134 lots and 17,505 blocks. Current legal status and reuse terms for the public ICAD geometry have not been confirmed.

requests.observation: City-centered viewer shell returned HTTP 200; its JavaScript bundle supplied the live API root.
HTTP 200, 1,054,233-byte SPA bundle; identifies Goiânia API and anonymous reader-token bootstrap.
HTTP 200; 196 active public ICAD layers. Layer 23548 is Lote, POLYGON, table/representation lote, publicoIcad=true.
HTTP 200; confirms layer metadata and extent SRID 3857.
HTTP 200; project extent covers Goiânia, approximately longitude -49.3966 to -49.178 and latitude -17.082 to -16.579.
HTTP 200; returns {"23548":[]} at WUP point. Same empty result for a ±0.002° WUP bbox, viewer opening point, and manual central fallback point.
HTTP 200; returns {"23548":[47189959]}. Response is layer-keyed geometry IDs; no paging fields are returned.
HTTP 200, 25,394-byte JSON record; full un-clipped POLYGON WKT has five ring coordinates. Personal/audit fields were not retained.

historicalContext.observation: Older official geoprocessing page describes requesting a free MUBDG map cutout from the department; it is not a live public feature API and may be stale.
Published SIGGO terms restrict database use to municipal departments and require permission for third-party use; redistribution is prohibited absent written consent.

verifiedParcelResponse.locationBasis: Selected from a small query around (-49.29338,-16.71996), approximately 2.2 km southwest of the WUP point; WUP, viewer-opening, and manual central locator queries returned no intersection.

source.name: Goiânia Geo 360° public ICAD layer Lote
source.operator: Official service owner: Prefeitura de Goiânia, SEPLAN. Platform brand is Geo 360; Topocart identifies GEO360 as its GIS platform and a 2026 city report mentions the Topocart Geo 360 contract. API is hosted on apis-goiania.geo360.com.br.
source.serviceType: Public-reader GET JSON API. Active viewer query: intersect-geom(ids,wkt) returning geometry IDs, followed by geometrias/{id} full record. A separate geometrias/camada/{id}?bbox= route returned full shapes in bounded probes; completeness semantics are unverified.
source.layer: 23548 (Lote; representation/table lote; project 3404 Base Cartográfica ICADPADRAO)
source.outputCrs: WGS 84 longitude/latitude in returned WKT; layer metadata extent SRID 3857
source.nativeIdEvidence: Intersection and bbox-list responses return current-namespace geometry ID 47189959, readable at /plataforma/geometrias/47189959. This is a stable lookup key for the observed sample, not asserted to be a legal cadastral parcel number.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal MUBDG describes blocks and lots; current city-linked Geo 360 ICAD layer 23548 is a public Lote polygon layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A full public Goiânia Lote polygon was retrieved from layer 23548. Queries at the WUP point and nearby ±0.002° bbox were empty; the verified sample is ~2.2 km southwest of the WUP point, so it does not establish coverage at the population center.

technicalBlocker: Bounded public sample reads work, but the candidate bbox-list route has no observed count, cursor, or complete ID-manifest contract. Citywide query completeness and coverage are not qualified. The empty WUP-point and ±0.002° intersections describe that locator only; they do not negate the verified city sample.
remainingUncertainty: Citywide geometry coverage and enumeration completeness; whether WUP-center parcels exist in the layer; official cadastral meaning of Geo 360 geometry IDs; public data-use terms remain informational and unconfirmed.
nextStep: Finish bounded protocol and coverage qualification, especially completeness and truncation behavior, before using this service in a runtime adapter. Use geometry ID 47189959 in its current Geo 360 namespace for the verified sample; no native cadastral-number gate is assumed.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.

Citywide query completeness and coverage are not qualified. The empty WUP-point and ±0.002° intersections describe that locator only; they do not negate the verified city sample.

registryBasis: The official Goiânia geoprocessing page directly links the Geo360 public viewer; its public Lote layer returned a full city parcel polygon.
